_about: Sofia Sanders, the demo persona (PLAN.md §3, §5.5). Her known-profile attributes live only here, keyed by life stage (CLAUDE.md). Phase 1 fills the student stage for the Student Portal dashboard; Phase 2 adds the prospect, alumni and learner stages and the identity stitch. Name, email, program, advisor and the Organic Chemistry storyline come from the demo-org narrative; every other value is a draft for Jesse to check against the org (PLAN.md §8.3). Course codes and the advisor id must exist in content/programs or content/faculty, or the build fails. Dates use {{facts.path}} tokens.

timeline.detail: Dropped CHEM 2310 mid-semester after missed labs and a low first exam. A W doesn't count toward GPA.

timeline.step: Early alert raised by Dr. Martinez
timeline.detail: Term GPA fell to 1.90, below good standing.
Met with Dr. Martinez: weekly chemistry study sessions at the Tutoring & Learning Center and a lighter spring course load.
Earned a B with weekly tutoring. Term GPA 3.30.
Back in good standing and on track to graduate with her class.
